rendered: The paper does not give a cost per kWh for the NFA pouch cell. The NFA 811[1] graphite pouch cell appears only in the formation and cycling data of Fig. 7[2], which reports no cost. The only $/kWh figure in the paper is the DOE cell cost target: "cell cost target is $80/kWh[3]". The paper says current manufacturing costs are "current manufacturing costs are about double this figure[4]", a general statement not specific to NFA. In Table 1[5], the Co-Free NFA section gives an energy density estimate of "250–275[6]" Wh/kg, which is an energy density, not a cost.
